up: Retrieve all IC50 activity records for the compound Chloroquine (CHEMBL76) and its salt forms, targeting Plasmodium falciparum (CHEMBL364). The query must join the molecule hierarchy to include salts/derivatives of the parent compound. Required output columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation, assay_chembl_id (from assays), and pubmed_id (from docs). Do not apply filters on standard_relation or standard_units beyond what is necessary to identify IC50 records. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT child.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, d.pubmed_id FROM molecule_dictionary parent JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = child.molregno JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = child.molregno JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL76' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL364' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
